app.name: PatientCase_AI
app.tagline: Tell your story once. Your doctor will have it ready.
portal.patient.desc: Register, answer questions and add your papers
placeholder.title: Coming in a later phase
placeholder.body: This screen is a placeholder. It will be built in phase {phase}.
patient.welcome.body: This screen will guide you step by step. Large buttons, your language, and a voice if you want it.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.error.network: Could not reach the server. Please try again.
signin.error.wrongPortal: This account belongs to another portal.
access.denied: You do not have access to this portal.
flow.language.title: Choose your language
flow.choose.title: Have you visited this hospital before?
flow.mobile.title: Your mobile number
flow.mobile.label: Mobile number (10 digits)
flow.mobile.hint: We will send you a 6-digit code.
flow.otp.title: Enter the code we sent
flow.otp.label: 6-digit code
flow.otp.locked: Staff will help you now. Please wait here.
flow.otp.tooMany: Too many tries. Staff will help you now.
flow.otp.expired: That code has expired. Please start again.
flow.error.invalid: Please check your details and try again.
flow.details.title: About you
flow.name: Full name
flow.regConsent: I agree to register and let the hospital keep these details for my visit.
flow.dup.title: Are you already registered?
flow.dup.body: We found a record with this mobile number. Is this you?
flow.dup.notMe: No, I am a different person
flow.lookup.title: How can we find you?
flow.lookup.aadhaarHint: 12 digits. We do not keep this number.
flow.lookup.notFound: We could not find you. Check the details or ask staff for help.
flow.consent.title: Your choices
consent.intro: Tell us what you agree to. You can change your mind later.
consent.his: Share with the hospital record system
consent.abha: Link to my ABHA health record
flow.consent.ended: Without permission to record your history we cannot continue. Please see the registration desk.
flow.done.title: You are registered
flow.done.next: Please sit in the waiting area. Staff will call you by your token number.
flow.mic.unsupported: Voice is not available here. Please type.
flow.mic.retry: We did not catch that. Please try again or type.
staff.register.consent: The patient has agreed to register and keep these details
staff.dup.title: Possible existing patients
interview.mode.title: How would you like to answer?
interview.mode.nextQuestion: The new choice starts from the next question.
interview.notCaught: I did not catch that. Please try again, or tap your answer.
interview.staffNotified: Staff have been told and will help you.
interview.helpSent: Staff have been called. Please wait here.
interview.criticalNote: This is important, so it is read aloud as well as shown.
interview.waitAudio: Please listen to the answer being read back.
interview.chooseMany: You can choose more than one.
interview.review.title: Please check your answers
interview.done.title: Thank you. Your answers are saved.
interview.done.body: You are all set. Please wait to be called.
alerts.title: Priority alerts
help.title: Help centre
help.reason.critical_answer_audio_unavai: Important answer could not be read aloud: please check it
queue.title: Queue
doctor.banner.title: Priority alert
interview.calm: Please wait. Staff will be with you shortly.
docs.title: Add your medical papers
docs.intro: Add old prescriptions, lab reports and hospital papers. You can add several.
docs.wait: Please wait while we read your papers.
docs.attentionNote: Some files need to be retaken or removed. You can also continue without them.
docs.reason.blurry: The photo is blurry. Please hold steady and retake it.
docs.reason.too_dark: The photo is too dark. Please retake it in better light.
docs.reason.low_resolution: The photo is too small to read. Please retake it closer.
docs.reason.cut_off_edges: Part of the page is cut off. Please retake it with the whole page in view.
docs.reason.blank_or_overexposed: The page looks blank or too bright. Please retake it.
docs.reason.unreadable: This file could not be opened. Please remove it or add it again.
docs.reason.scanned_pdf: This PDF is a scan we cannot read yet. Please add a photo of the page instead.
docs.reason.no_text_found: We could not find any writing. Please retake the photo.
docs.reason.processing_failed: We could not read this file. Please retake it or remove it.
docs.error.unsupported_type: Only photos and PDF files can be added.
docs.error.too_large: This file is too big. The limit is {mb} MB.
docs.error.too_many_files: You have added the most files allowed ({max}).
docs.error.too_many_pages: This PDF has too many pages. The limit is {max}.
docs.error.network: Could not reach the server. Please try again.
docs.error.consent_required: Papers cannot be added because you did not give permission.
docs.error.already_submitted: Your papers have already been submitted.
analysis.title: Case analysis
analysis.pick: Choose a patient to see the analysis.
analysis.pending: {n} file(s) are still being read. The results will update by themselves.
analysis.draft: Decision support only, not a diagnosis. The drug, interaction and lab lists are drafts that a pharmacist and a clinician have not yet reviewed. Check every flagged item against the original file.
analysis.loadError: The analysis could not be loaded.
analysis.sec.meds: Medicines, merged from all files and answers
analysis.signal.name: name differs
analysis.issue.date_in_future: {file}: the date {date} is after this visit.
analysis.issue.lab_conflict: {test} on {date}: the files give different values.
analysis.issue.medication_conflict: {drug} on {date}: the files give different doses.
analysis.issue.patient_reports_no_medici: The patient said they take no medicines, but the files list: {list}.
analysis.issue.unknown_drug: Not in the drug list, check by hand: {name}.
analysis.issue.unknown_test: Not in the test list, check by hand: {name}.
analysis.issue.unit_not_comparable: {test}: the units ({units}) cannot be compared safely.
analysis.int.none: No interaction found among the medicines that could be checked.
analysis.int.unchecked: Not checked, because they are not in the drug list: {names}.
analysis.effect.reduced_activation: May reduce how well one of them works
analysis.effect.kidney_and_blood_pressur: May affect the kidneys and blood pressure control
analysis.effect.gi_bleeding: Higher risk of stomach or gut bleeding
analysis.effect.drug_toxicity: May raise the level of one drug to a harmful amount
analysis.effect.dual_blockade: Two drugs of the same kind of action on blood pressure and kidneys
analysis.effect.severe_low_blood_pressur: Risk of a severe fall in blood pressure
analysis.effect.masked_low_sugar: May hide the warning signs of low blood sugar
analysis.allergy.notAnswered: The allergy question was not answered.
analysis.allergy.listMissing: The patient reported an allergy but did not name it.
analysis.allergy.conflict: {drug} may conflict with the reported allergy: {allergen}
analysis.med.name: Medicine
analysis.med.none: No change in dose or frequency.
analysis.med.change.unit_mismatch: Doses are in different units: {from} and {to}
analysis.lab.sameDate: same date as the one before
ws.scan.title: Original scan
ws.scan.openFile: Open the file in a new tab
ws.scan.noPosition: The exact position of this value on the page is not known.
ws.summary.notReady: The patient has not submitted yet, so there is no summary.
ws.summary.draftNote: This is a draft prepared from the patient's answers and files. It states facts and their sources, and makes no diagnosis. You decide: accept, amend or reject it.
ws.error.action: That did not work. Please try again.
ws.manual.title: Document the history manually
ws.files.title: Files
ws.files.failed: Could not be read, not included
ws.complete.title: Completeness
ws.diagnosticWarning: This summary contains wording that may state a diagnosis. Please review it.
ws.versions.title: Version history
ws.queue.title: Today's queue
ws.shortcuts: Keys: J next, K previous, 1 to 6 tabs, O open case, A accept.
flow.submit.error: We could not send your answers. Please try again.
flow.done.audio: Thank you. Your answers and papers have been sent. Please wait for your token to be called.
ws.observe: To be observed by the physician
interview.paused.title: Your answers are saved.
interview.paused.body: You can rest now. Ask staff, or sign in again, and we will continue from the same question.
signin.codeHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
deliveries.title: Delivery of confirmed summaries
deliveries.reason.no_consent: The patient did not agree to this.
deliveries.reason.no_abha_identifier: The patient has no ABHA number on record.
deliveries.reason.invalid_bundle: The record failed its checks and was not sent.

admin.accounts.title: Staff, doctor and admin accounts
admin.field.name: Full name
admin.tempPasswordNote: Shown only once. Give it to the person in private; they should change it after signing in.
admin.error.generic: That did not work. Check the details and try again.
admin.error.name_taken: A department with that name exists.

bell.title: Notifications
help.support: Need help? Ask the department helper first, then hospital IT. The support path and what to do when something fails are in the rollout runbook.

dash.sub.clinical: Today's patients, alerts and summaries at a glance.
dash.sub.admin: Accounts, sign-ins, audit events and the health of the system.

ws.overview.title: Overview of the patient's history

ws.overview.byRules: Written automatically from the recorded answers and files by fixed rules.

ws.overview.fellBack: The model's text did not pass the checks, so the rule-based text is shown.

flow.recap.pending: Writing a short recap of your answers…
flow.recap.byAi: Written automatically by an AI model from your answers.
flow.recap.doctor: The doctor will go through everything with you.

landing.sub: Patients share their history in their own language, by voice or touch. Staff see who needs help first. Doctors open one clear, ready summary.
landing.privacy: Consent for every purpose. Development uses synthetic data only.
landing.f1.title: Voice in 3 languages
landing.f1.body: English, Hindi and Marathi. Speak, tap or read, one question at a time.
landing.f2.title: Red flags in real time
landing.f2.body: Emergency answers alert the staff desk the moment they are given.
landing.f3.title: Papers read for you
landing.f3.body: Prescriptions and lab reports are read, checked and lined up.
landing.f4.title: Summary, ready
landing.f4.body: The doctor opens one summary instead of a pile of papers.
signin.lead: Sign in to continue to the {portal} portal.
signin.error.locked: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
steps.label: Your progress
display.title: Display
landing.how.title: How it works for patients
landing.how.s1.body: Choose your language and confirm your number with a code sent by SMS.
landing.how.s2.body: One question at a time. Speak or touch your answer. Add photos of old papers if you have them.
landing.how.s3.body: Staff call you by your token number. The doctor already has your summary.
flow.sub.language: Everything after this will be shown in the language you choose.
flow.sub.choose: If you have come here before, we can find your old record.
flow.sub.lookup: Choose any one. Your PatientCase ID is printed on your old slip.
flow.sub.mobile: We use it only to confirm that it is you.
flow.sub.otp: Look for the SMS on your phone. The code works for 5 minutes.
flow.sub.details: Fields marked optional can be left empty.
flow.mobile.badStart: Indian mobile numbers start with 6, 7, 8 or 9. Please check the number.
flow.otp.resend: Did not get the code? Send it again
flow.otp.resent: A new code has been sent.
consent.history.desc: Needed to continue. Your answers are saved for your doctor.
consent.documents.desc: Lets you add photos of old prescriptions and reports.
consent.his.desc: Sends your summary to the hospital's own record system.
consent.abha.desc: Connects this visit to your national ABHA health ID.
interview.mode.listen_speak.desc: We read each question aloud. You answer by speaking.
interview.mode.listen_tap.desc: We read each question aloud. You answer by touching the screen.
interview.mode.read_tap.desc: You read each question and touch your answer. Best in a noisy place.
interview.pickFirst: Choose an answer, or press Skip if you do not know.
flow.mic.denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it from the lock icon in the address bar, or type your answer.
flow.mic.noMic: No microphone was found. Please check it is plugged in, or type your answer.
flow.mic.network: Voice needs an internet connection right now. Please type, or try again in a moment.
flow.mic.noDigits: We did not hear any numbers. Please say the digits one by one, or type them.
interview.heardNoMatch: We heard “{text}” but it does not match an answer. Please try again using the words on the screen, or tap your answer.
help.reason.ai_attention: The AI interviewer suggests a prompt look at this patient
urgent.label: Urgent help
urgent.note: If you feel very unwell, tell a staff member now.
urgent.again: Staff are coming. Press again if needed
urgent.sent: Staff have been told. Please stay where you are. Someone is coming.
urgent.failed: We could not reach staff. Please call out or tell the nearest staff member now.
help.reason.urgent_help: URGENT: the patient pressed the urgent help button
